review.en: Twenty-six prose poems in which the prophet Almustafa, about to sail home, answers the people of Orphalese on love, marriage, children, work, joy and sorrow, death. Written in English by a Lebanese-American poet and painter, it has sold in vast numbers and is read at weddings and funerals. Its cadence is lovely; its wisdom is broad rather than deep.
review.zh: 二十六篇散文诗：先知亚墨斯达法即将乘船返乡，回答奥法利斯城人们关于爱、婚姻、孩子、工作、欢乐与悲伤、死亡的提问。作者是黎巴嫩裔美国诗人和画家，用英文写成。它销量极大，常在婚礼和葬礼上被朗读。节奏优美，智慧宽而不深。冰心 1931 年的中译本流传很广。
